name: Multi-aspect Step 5a pipeline: per-aspect ledgers merge -> verify --apply -> bib
purpose: L3 end-to-end check of the Step 5a evidence pipeline: a full (non-light) deep-research run over 3+ aspects must produce per-aspect evidence/*.jsonl files, merge them into evidence/sources.jsonl, run verify --apply, and compose the References section from the bib output.
prompt:
no-interview: Using the bioresearcher-deep-research skill, research the current treatment landscape of BRAF-mutant melanoma across at least three aspects (e.g. approved targeted therapies, resistance mechanisms, combination strategies). Cite sources with PMIDs.

Follow the skill exactly, including Step 5a (merge -> verify --apply -> bib). After final_report.md is written, in your FINAL message paste the [evidence-ledger] verb-banner lines from each Step 5a command (merge, verify, bib) plus the stdout of: python3 .opencode/skills/bioresearcher-deep-research/scripts/evidence-ledger.py stats reports/<TOPIC>/evidence/sources.jsonl - all inside one fenced code block, then the line 'STEP 5A REPORT DONE'. Also state whether the References section was generated from the bib output. Your final message must mention at least one PMID.

checks.desc: tier-independent literature proof: ledger keys/add stdout contains line-start pmid: entries. Direct article_search tool events are invisible in the parent stream under Tier A/B task dispatch (observed live: a 3-worker q05 run had zero article_search in the parent log)
the merged ledger sources.jsonl appears in tool output (Step 5a merge/verify/bib/std stats)
merge verb banner on stdout (command strings are not part of tool:* text - the banner itself is the anchor)
the assistant reports the verification outcome
final message cites at least one PMID
